gloss: to ignore; to disregard; to pay no attention to

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {無視|むし}していませんでした

definitions.gloss: to ignore; to disregard; to pay no attention to
definitions.explanation: To deliberately not acknowledge or respond to something or someone. Can refer to ignoring a person, a rule, a warning, or a fact.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メッセージ→メッセージ：03828_messeeji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{無視|むし}した。
⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{無視|むし}して⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
examples.english: It's dangerous to cross while ignoring the traffic signal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{忠告|ちゅうこく}→忠告：05462_chuukoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{無視|むし}して⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧さらに⟦{悪化|あっか}した→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧。
examples.english: I ignored the doctor's advice and pushed myself, and my condition got even worse.

notes:
USAGE:
The object being ignored is marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧. Very commonly used in daily conversation and writing. Can describe both deliberate ignoring of a person (giving the silent treatment) and disregarding rules or advice.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{無視|むし}する (run a traffic light)
- ⟦{忠告|ちゅうこく}→忠告：05462_chuukoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{無視|むし}する (ignore advice)
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{無視|むし}する (disregard someone's opinion)
- ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{無視|むし}する (completely ignore)
- ⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{無視|むし}する (ignore someone's existence)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無視|むし}→無視：13473_mushi⟧: the noun form, also very common ({無視|むし}される 'to be ignored')
- ⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{見|み}ぬ→見る：00283_miru⟧ふり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pretend not to see — implies awareness but choosing not to act
- ⟦{放|ほう}っておく→放っておく：18382_houtteoku⟧: to leave alone — less deliberate; can mean simply not dealing with something
